exec.description: Run one shell line on this machine and return its stdout, its stderr and how it ended. No window is opened. The line runs under sh -c (cmd /c on Windows) in a process group of its own, with no stdin and the daemon's environment less the pane, session and agent variables of the command that started the daemon, as a pane gets it. The group is stopped at the timeout, when the caller goes away, and when the daemon stops. Each stream keeps its last 1 MiB. At most 8 run at once. Over a link it needs open, as new-window does.

params.name: line
params.description: The command line, parsed by the shell, at most 16384 bytes.

params.name: cwd
params.description: Directory to run in. It must exist. Omit for the daemon's home directory.

params.name: timeout_ms
params.description: How long the line may run, in milliseconds, at most one hour. Omit for 30000.

returns.name: stdout
returns.description: What the line wrote to stdout, base64 in JSON.

returns.name: stderr
returns.description: What the line wrote to stderr, base64 in JSON.

returns.name: stdout_dropped
returns.description: Bytes cut from the start of stdout to keep the last 1 MiB.

returns.name: stderr_dropped
returns.description: Bytes cut from the start of stderr to keep the last 1 MiB.

returns.name: exit
returns.description: The exit status. Absent when the line was stopped by a signal, the timeout or the caller leaving.

returns.name: signal
returns.description: The signal that stopped the line, such as killed. Absent when it exited.

returns.name: signal_number
returns.description: The number of that signal, such as 9.
